answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. This matters because the cost of running many aliases grows faster than the influence they can exert, making the attack economically self-defeating. Consider a jetty as the anchor of the cost.
